description: Implementation of the Ralph Method orchestrator in the CLAI Go/Bubble Tea TUI.

userStories.title: PRD Management Engine (internal/ralph)
userStories.description: Build the core I/O engine for reading/writing/watching the PRD.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement internal/ralph package with PRD and UserStory structs.
Add strict schema validation: Fail on start with descriptive error if .clai/prd.json is invalid.
Implement async loading in UI: Init() returns a cmd that loads the PRD.
Implement FSWatcher: TUI mission pane hot-reloads when prd.json is modified externally.
Ensure story list is sorted primarily by priority (ascending) and secondarily by array order.
userStories.notes: Ralph owns the data logic; UI model just renders it.

userStories.title: Multi-file Markdown Persistent Memory
userStories.description: Implement the split-file logging system in .clai/ directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Create logic to manage .clai/progress.txt (log stream) and .clai/patterns.md (reusable patterns).
Implement single-writer queue in Model: All sub-agent logs go through a central channel to prevent race conditions.
Timestamped entries: format must be '## [TIMESTAMP] | Story: [ID]'.
Include git hash in progress log body for audit trails.
Implement context truncation: If log grows too large, logic is ready to reference sub-documents.
userStories.notes: Patterns.md should be treated as the 'System Prompt Addendum' for all future iterations.

userStories.title: The Ralph Main Loop & State Machine
userStories.description: Implement the core orchestration logic and UI indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard state: 'R' key only starts the loop if m.Stage == StageIdle.
Active Story Styling: Use Lipgloss to highlight the current 'Thinking' story (different from Pending/Passed).
Context Gathering: Pre-flight stage that reads patterns, history, and workspace files relevant to the active story.
Completion Banner: If all stories pass, display 'Nothing to do' centered/visible message.
Interruption: 'ESC' or 'S' key triggers context cancellation to halt loop safely.
userStories.notes: Bubble Tea Update functionality becomes the 'Brain' that picks the next story.

userStories.title: Concurrent Work Stream & Viewport
userStories.description: Implement background worker goroutines and the Work Stream UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Structured Messaging: Use Go channels for SubagentAction, SubagentThinking, and SubagentError messages.
Context Cancellation: Sub-agent goroutine is tied to a context.Context that dies when the program quits or stops.
Work Stream Viewport: Right pane supports manual scrolling to review logs while agent is active.
Auto-scroll: Viewport sticks to bottom during active output unless manually scrolled up.
Concurrency Safety: Ensure no blocking calls in the main UI thread during heavy LLM/Build operations.
userStories.notes: Use p.Send() for thread-safe UI updates from sub-agent goroutines.

userStories.title: Verification Gates & Git Automation
userStories.description: Implement the quality-check and self-healing loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Verification: Sub-agent runs 'go test ./...' and 'go build' before completion.
Self-Heal Loop: Configurable max attempts (default 3) to fix errors before marking story 'Blocked'.
Atomic Git: Automated commit 'feat: [ID] - [Title]' only on verification success; commits per-story.
Branch Guard: Orchestrator verifies current branch matches prd.json 'branchName' and auto-checks it out if not.
Audit Trail: Commit body includes a brief summary of the sub-agent's work and link to progress log timestamp.
userStories.notes: Autonomous by default; no human intervention needed for 'VER' stage.
